query_str: What is the escalation path for a delayed shipment?
response: Delayed shipments are escalated to the regional logistics lead after 48 hours.

node.text: If a shipment is delayed by more than 48 hours the case is escalated to the regional logistics lead, who owns the carrier relationship.
Carrier relationships are reviewed quarterly by the logistics team; the regional lead chairs the review.
The onboarding checklist for new warehouse staff covers safety equipment and shift handover.
